name: Barista
blurb: Pull shots behind Jun's counter and learn how regulars decide what to buy.

perk.desc: Free coffee at Bloom Coffee while you work there.

lines: The 8 AM rush: forty flat whites and one oat-milk emergency.
A regular tells you she only buys what she can see on the counter. Noted.
You learn the milk steamer's moods. Jun nods, approvingly.
Slow afternoon. You wipe tables and watch who comes back twice.
